ticket.title: My workspace invitation expired
ticket.body: I received an invitation four days ago. Opening it now says the invitation has expired. What should I do to join the workspace?

review.reply:
Your workspace invitation expires 72 hours after issuance. Since it has expired, you cannot join using that invitation. Please request a new invitation from the workspace administrator. They can issue a fresh invitation via Settings > Members > Invite member.

Use the most recent invitation email.
review.note: Demonstration review by build agent against example documentation. Confirmed the documented72-hour expiry and administrator invitation path. Added the documented reminder to use the most recent invitation email.

citations.quote: Workspace invitations expire 72 hours after they are issued. An expired invitation cannot be reactivated by the recipient. A workspace administrator can open Settings > Members > Invite member and issue a new invitation to the same email.
